name: words_at_time
description: Which words play at a timeline time, or in a timeline range, through the project's current cut. Reads the tracks and each source's word timings every call, so it is right after any edit; never reuse an older transcript's times. Read-only.

input.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

output.description: {start, end, count, words: [{text, start, end, source, sourceStart, sourceEnd, item, track}]} with start/end in timeline seconds, ordered by start

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: t
params.description: One timeline time in seconds. Use this or start and end.

params.name: start
params.description: Range start on the timeline, in seconds. Needs end.

params.name: end
params.description: Range end on the timeline, in seconds. Needs start.

params.name: track
params.description: Only this track id. Leave out for every track.
